capabilities: Archive current, selected or whole-folder files to a configurable archive folder
Restore archived files to original paths and undo the latest archive
Archive linked attachments together with their note
Route folders to per-folder archive destinations and protect paths from archiving
Archive stale files untouched for a chosen number of days
disambiguation: Not a backup or sync tool; it only moves files within the vault into an archive folder.
extras: Requires Obsidian 1.13 or later; fully local with no network access, accounts or telemetry; archive history capped at 200 records; batch archives over 10 files ask for confirmation.
intentEvidence: Choose whether Delete asks each time, archives automatically, or uses Obsidian’s normal delete flow.
problem: Obsidian only offers delete or trash, so notes you do not need now but may want later are either lost or keep cluttering the vault.
summary: File-management plugin that archives notes instead of deleting them, with restore, undo, linked-attachment handling and archive metadata.
